sentence: Hoje não está fazendo calor nenhum.
ipa: ˈɔʒ ˈnɐ̃w̃ eˈʃta fɐˈzẽd kɐˈloɾ nɨˈɲỹ
gloss_en: It is not hot at all today.
notes: Gerund progressive 'está fazendo' is the southern/Alentejano register per cunha_cintra1984; final unstressed vowel deletion (hoje->[ˈɔʒ], fazendo->[ˈfɐzẽd]) per brissos2014; stressed /u/->[y] in 'nenhum' per cintra1971.

sentence: Este cabaz custa nove euros e não mais.
ipa: ˈeʃt kɐˈbaʃ ˈkyʃtɐ ˈnɔv ˈewɾuz i ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈmajʃ
gloss_en: This basket costs nine euros and no more.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] in 'custa' per cintra1971 and brissos2014; final-vowel deletion (este->[ˈeʃt], nove->[ˈnɔv]) per brissos2014; 'euros e' liaison and coda [ʃ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Tenho consulta na quinta-feira às nove horas.
ipa: ˈtɛɲ kõˈsyɫtɐ nɐ ˈkĩtɐ ˈfeɾɐ aʒ ˈnɔv ˈɔɾɐʃ
gloss_en: I have an appointment on Thursday at nine.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] with dark coda [ɫ] in 'consulta' per cintra1971 and brissos2014; /ej/->[e] monophthong in 'feira' per cintra1971; 'às nove' regressive voicing to [ʒ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A minha família mora numa aldeia pequena.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ fɐˈmiliɐ ˈmɔɾɐ ˈnymɐ ɐˈɫdeɐ pɨˈkɛnɐ
gloss_en: My family lives in a small village.
notes: /ej/->[e] in 'aldeia' with dark coda [ɫ] per cintra1971; palatal [ɲ] in 'minha' per mateus_dandrade2000; stressed /u/->[y] in 'numa' per brissos2014.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue sempre em frente.
ipa: ˈviɾɐ a diˈɾetɐ i ˈsɨɡ ˈsẽpɾ ɐ̃j̃ ˈfɾẽt
gloss_en: Turn right and keep going straight ahead.
notes: /ej/->[e] in 'direita' per cintra1971; final-vowel deletion (segue->[ˈsɨɡ], frente->[ˈfɾẽt]) per brissos2014; imperative register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Este bacalhau está muito salgado.
ipa: ˈeʃt bɐkɐˈʎaw eˈʃta ˈmujt ˈsɐɫɡa
gloss_en: This cod is very salty.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'bacalhau' per mateus_dandrade2000; dark coda [ɫ] and intervocalic /d/ deletion with final loss in 'salgado'->[ˈsɐɫɡa] per brissos2014.

sentence: Onde fica a estação dos comboios?
ipa: ˈõd ˈfikɐ ɐ eʃtɐˈsɐ̃w̃ duʃ kõˈbojuʃ
gloss_en: Where is the train station?
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'estação' per mateus_dandrade2000; final-vowel deletion (onde->[ˈõd]) per brissos2014; interrogative register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quantos quilos de pão queres?
ipa: kwɐ̃ˈtuʃ ˈkiluʒ d ˈpɐ̃w̃ kɛˈɾɨʃ
gloss_en: How many kilos of bread do you want?
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'pão' and coda [ʃ]/[ʒ] per mateus_dandrade2000; open-mid [ɛ] in 'queres' per cintra1971.

sentence: Se chovesse, ficávamos em casa.
ipa: s ʃuˈvɛs̺ fiˈkavɐmuz ɐ̃j̃ ˈkazɐ
gloss_en: If it rained, we would stay home.
notes: [ʃ] onset in 'chovesse' and open-mid [ɛ] per mateus_dandrade2000; conditional-imperfect frame per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Ontem comprei peixe fresco no mercado.
ipa: ˈõtɐ̃j̃ kõˈpɾe ˈpeʃ ˈfɾeʃk nu ˈmɨɾka
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought fresh fish at the market.
notes: /ej/->[e] in 'comprei' and 'peixe' per cintra1971; intervocalic /d/ deletion with final loss in 'mercado'->[ˈmɨɾka] per brissos2014.

sentence: Para o ano estou pensando em ir até ao Porto.
ipa: ˈpaɾɐ u ˈɐn eˈʃto pɨ̃ˈsɐ̃d ɐ̃j̃ ˈiɾ ɐˈtɛ aw ˈpoɾt
gloss_en: Next year I am planning to go to Porto.
notes: Gerund progressive 'estou pensando' is the Alentejano register per cunha_cintra1984; /ow/->[o] in 'estou' and 'para o'/'até ao' liaison per cintra1971.

sentence: Liga-me mais tarde, se fazes favor.
ipa: ˈliɡɐ m ˈmajʃ ˈtaɾd s ˈfazɨʃ fɐˈvɔɾ
gloss_en: Call me later, please.
notes: Coda [ʃ] in 'mais' and open-mid [ɔ] in 'favor' per mateus_dandrade2000; clitic imperative 'liga-me' per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Olá, então tudo bem contigo?
ipa: oˈla ẽˈtɐ̃w̃ ˈty ˈbɐ̃j̃ kõˈtiɡ
gloss_en: Hi, so are you doing well?
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] with final-vowel deletion in 'tudo'->[ˈty] per cintra1971 and brissos2014; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'então' per mateus_dandrade2000; greeting register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quem não arrisca, não petisca.
ipa: ˈkɐ̃j̃ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ɐˈʁiʃkɐ ˈnɐ̃w̃ pɨˈtiʃkɐ
gloss_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
notes: Strong [ʁ] from 'rr' in 'arrisca' per mateus_dandrade2000; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'não'; proverb attested in cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: O sul é lindo quando o céu está azul.
ipa: u ˈsyɫ ˈɛ ˈlĩd ˈkwɐ̃d u ˈsɛw eˈʃta ɐˈzyɫ
gloss_en: The south is beautiful when the sky is blue.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] with dark coda [ɫ] in 'sul' and 'azul' per cintra1971 and brissos2014; open-mid [ɛ] in 'céu' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Ele trouxe um ramo de flores roxas.
ipa: ˈel ˈtɾos ˈũ ˈʁam d ˈflɔɾɨʒ ˈʁɔʃɐʃ
gloss_en: He brought a bunch of purple flowers.
notes: Strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'ramo'/'roxas' and /ow/->[o] in 'trouxe' per cintra1971; coda [ʒ]/[ʃ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A velha ponte de pedra ainda aguenta.
ipa: ɐ ˈvɛʎɐ ˈpõt d ˈpɛdɾɐ ˈaj̃dɐ ɐˈɡẽtɐ
gloss_en: The old stone bridge still holds.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'velha' and open-mid [ɛ] in 'pedra' per mateus_dandrade2000; nasal [õ] in 'ponte' per cintra1971.

sentence: Aquele rapaz vende jornais na esquina.
ipa: ˈɐkɛl ʁɐˈpaʒ ˈvẽd ʒuˈɾnajʒ nɐ eˈʃkinɐ
gloss_en: That young man sells newspapers on the corner.
notes: Strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'rapaz', coda [ʒ] in 'jornais' and coda [ʃ] in 'esquina' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O melhor vinho branco vem do Douro.
ipa: u mɨˈʎɔɾ ˈviɲ ˈbɾɐ̃k ˈvɐ̃j̃ du ˈdoɾ
gloss_en: The best white wine comes from the Douro.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'melhor' and [ɲ] in 'vinho' per mateus_dandrade2000; /ow/->[o] in 'Douro' per cintra1971.

sentence: Ando trabalhando na horta desde manhã.
ipa: ˈɐ̃d tɾɐbɐˈʎɐ̃d nɐ ˈɔɾtɐ ˈdɛʃd mɐˈɲã
gloss_en: I have been working in the vegetable garden since morning.
notes: Gerund progressive 'ando trabalhando' is the Alentejano register per cunha_cintra1984; palatal [ʎ] in 'trabalhando' and [ɲ] in 'manhã' per mateus_dandrade2000; final-vowel deletion in 'desde'->[ˈdɛʃd] per brissos2014.
